name: workflow-file-ownership
body:
source: review finding — the File nodes `.github/workflows/native-e2e.yml` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` had no `implemented-by` edge from a solution *component* (the spine invariant: every repo/CI artefact is anchored to the component that owns it; `.github/workflows/release.yml` was already owned by solution.component.release-workflow and solution.component.linux-release-asset).

INCONSISTENCY: (a) `.github/workflows/native-e2e.yml` had no owner at any level; (b) `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s only `implemented-by` came from the grouping container solution.container.release-pipeline — contradicting the documented spine convention that C4 grouping nodes (system/containers) carry no direct `implemented-by` and anchor through their contained components (solution.note.spine-tier3-anchors).

RESOLUTION: [autonomous]
- Anchored `.github/workflows/native-e2e.yml` to solution.component.native-e2e-ci (the reusable workflow that runs TestNativeRelease and the other pinned e2e tests), keeping its existing `e2e.TestNativeRelease` and `e2e/native_test.go` anchors.
- Added solution.component.ci-workflow, contained by solution.container.release-pipeline (which holds native-e2e-ci and release-workflow), `implemented-by .github/workflows/ci.yml`. Its body describes the PR/push gate: the `macos-14` `test` job (gofmt gate, `go vet`, `make build`, module-path guard, `go test ./...`) and the `native-e2e` job that delegates to the reusable `.github/workflows/native-e2e.yml`. Its realisation was first recorded as `realised-by domain.service.publish-release` — see the UPDATE below; that was superseded by `realised-by domain.service.verify-changes`.
- Removed the grouping-level `implemented-by solution.container.release-pipeline -> .github/workflows/ci.yml`: with the component owner in place, release-pipeline is anchored through its contained components, restoring the documented invariant.

UPDATE (section-helpers/feedback-14) [with user]: the realisation recorded above as `realised-by domain.service.publish-release` was inaccurate. publish-release is defined only for a consented tag (build one binary per supported target, verify each natively, publish with checksums, update the package manifests) and its driving requirement requirements.requirement.native-ci-verification is release-scoped; ci-workflow is the PR/push gate (ci.yml) and publishes nothing, so it does not mirror native-e2e-ci and release-workflow, which run as part of a release. Corrected: ci-workflow is now `realised-by domain.service.verify-changes` — a domain node contained by domain.group.distribution, driven by requirements.requirement.source-repo (the module-path guard enforces its AC), requirements.requirement.native-ci-verification (the native e2e the gate runs via the reusable workflow) and requirements.requirement.distribution (the 'built, verified' pipeline requirement). The `realised-by domain.service.publish-release -> solution.component.ci-workflow` edge was removed; publish-release keeps release-workflow and native-e2e-ci. See solution.note.feedback-14-ci-workflow.

RESULT (queried on this branch): every File under `.github/workflows/` is owned by a solution component — `ci.yml` (ci-workflow), `native-e2e.yml` (native-e2e-ci), `release.yml` (release-workflow, linux-release-asset); no workflow file remains unowned.
